question: Related Questions Q. New Muslim Issues 2596 views Q. My question is in what way a muslim female can contribute towards the responsibility of dawat n tableeg? 3155 views Q. Is it permissible to use internet forums where males and females engage in online Islamic discussions? 4185 views Q. Currently I am making up all my missed Saums (Fasting ) from the previous years. Now,in the 3rd week of Dec'2007,I am going for 40 Days Jamat, InshaAllah. Now, on those 40 days, shall I keep "Nafl Roza Intention" or keep making up my "missed Saum Intention." Please advise ? I was reading this Hadith, so the above question came to my mind. "Whoever keeps fast for one day while out in the path of Allah, Allah will (certainly) keep him from the fire of Jahannam a distance of seventy years in place of that one day. (Bukhaari and Muslim) ------------ Also please advise Top 5 things (Amaal) I should do in my 40 Days Jamat. 1861 views Q. Some popular singer in Pakistan has recently the Tableeghi Jama'at. A friend of mine the other day argued with that since the singer has earned money through a haram activity, that is to say, through singing, he first of all should get rid of his harmam money and then he should join the Tableeghi Jama'at, and do the Tableegh. I just could not satisfy him. Please guide me in this connection as to he should get rid of his haram money first, and then should join Tableegh? As a child I was educated in convent English schools. Due to our ignorance we used to say prayers in school which today I feel was Shirk. For e.g. one of our prayers was "Jesus hear us, we pray .. Keep us safe through this day..... Jesus Lord hear our pray may we rest in thy care" Similarly as teenagers due to our ignorance we used to participate with Hindus praying to their idols during varios festivals. all this was grave shirk as i realized today. since the time I realized this, I have not been able to have peace of mind and constantly ask Allah for forgiveness in prayers. But is there something which I should do so that my heart and soul are free from the guilt of the grave sin committed in childhood and teenage. Please guide me. Allah hafiz Thank you 2681 views Q. Distribution of Translation of the Holy Quran to Non-Muslims 4692 views Q. I am a college student at Srinagar Kashmir.being a muslim majority region many Islamic organizations are working here according to their ideologies & the conditions prevailing here. Amid such situation it is natural to have conflicts between different ideologies. But the problem arises when different schools of thought start rejecting each other and go to such an extent that they call eachother KAFIR , and other ideologies as BATIL. Still they may not feel any problem for themselves ,but it does become a problem for a common man when he tries return towards the Din of Allah, or when he becomes serious about Islam and wishes to work in the way of Allah . because it is a must to join an organization to work in a coordinated and fruitfull manner . but at this moment one has to decide which organization is on truth (Islam) . I?m in a similar dilemma as which way to choose to work in an organizational setup. Probably I was fortunate to meet a pious man who reminded me of our real aim in life and helped me to motivate myself to lead an Islamic way of life . he himself belongs to jamait-e-Islami. when looking onto the good points every organization has a sizeable list on the other hand if we try to point out the bad points there also we get many. and these are used by people for criticism . the various org here are jamait-e- islami , dadul uloom Deoband, Jamait ?e- ahl-e-hahith, Tableegi jamaat , Barailvi, Tehreek-e- hurriyat and many others . the good and bad points in each of themand as such one gets confused , and con not easily find out the whole of it by self study .. In this regard I request you to help me in searching out the pure Islam Your advice is very crucial to me because it is about the most important decision of my life and on it may rest the Judgment on the day of Judgment. Also plz pray for my guidance and sucess. Wa salaam 3204 views Q. answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Dawah & Tableeg Question ID: 14157 Country: India Title: Assalam Alaikum, I am very much inspired by the great Islam and have many doubts in my mind. so this is my way to clear all my doubts. Thanks to you, may ALLAH bless you all peace. My question is that- Were KRISHNA and BUDHHA prophets of ALLAH. As I heard or read in Quran that it is mentioned somewhere for KRishna- KAAN FI AL- HIND NABIDA ASWAD AL- LALOON ISMA KAHAN. And for Budhha-ZUAL-KIFL. Salamualeykum Question: Assalam Alaikum, I am very much inspired by the great Islam and have many doubts in my mind. so this is my way to clear all my doubts. Salamualeykum Answer ID: 14157 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1160/963=D/1430) You are inspired by Islam, may Allah grant you the boon of Islam and make your heart open to accept the same. You should study the book of Hadhrat Maulana Manzoor Nomani named ?Islam kya Hai? It is available in Urdu, Hindi and English in book depots in Delhi , Lucknow and Deoband etc. (2) We have no sure knowledge of the matter. The sentence ? kaan fil hind ?? is not from the Quran. For some personality to be prophet, we cannot say with surety just on the basis of doubt and speculation, rather we will keep quite in such matters, the knowledge of the reality rests only in Allah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
